nodes.description: Address of the contract owner set in Ownable and BoltFinance constructor.
Boolean pause flag in Pausable controlling whenNotPaused/whenPaused modifiers.
Total token supply, increased by mint and decreased by _burn.
Mapping of address to token balance updated in transfer, transferFrom, mint and _burn.
Nested allowance mapping updated in approve, increaseApproval, decreaseApproval and transferFrom.
Mapping of address to blacklist flag checked in transfer/transferFrom and written by _blackList.
Token name string set once in the constructor.
Token symbol string set once in the constructor.
Token decimals used in constructor supply scaling.
SafeMath.add returns a+b with an overflow assert.
SafeMath.sub returns a-b with an underflow assert.
Ownable.transferOwnership guarded by onlyOwner, writes owner state variable.
Pausable.pause sets paused to true, onlyOwner and whenNotPaused.
Pausable.unpause sets paused to false, onlyOwner and whenPaused.
StandardToken.transfer moves balances after blacklist and balance checks using SafeMath.sub/add.
StandardToken.transferFrom moves balances and decrements allowance using SafeMath.sub/add.
StandardToken.approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender.
StandardToken.increaseApproval adds to the allowance using SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval reduces allowance, using a local oldValue and SafeMath.sub.
StandardToken._blackList internal function writing tokenBlacklist state.
PausableToken.blackListAddress, onlyOwner and whenNotPaused, delegates to super._blackList.
BoltFinance constructor initializes name, symbol, decimals, totalSupply, balances and owner.
BoltFinance.burn external entry point that burns msg.sender tokens via _burn.
BoltFinance._burn internal routine subtracting balance and totalSupply with SafeMath.
BoltFinance.mint, onlyOwner, increases totalSupply and account balance with SafeMath.add.
Untrusted msg.sender used for authorization checks and balance/allowance indexing.
Balance subtraction and addition inside transfer; arithmetic manipulation point.
Balance and allowance subtraction inside transferFrom; arithmetic manipulation point.
totalSupply and balances addition inside mint; arithmetic manipulation point.
onlyOwner authorization gate protecting mint against unauthorized supply creation.
onlyOwner/whenNotPaused authorization gate protecting blackListAddress.
onlyOwner gate and owner reassignment inside transferOwnership.
Balance and totalSupply subtraction inside _burn; arithmetic manipulation point.

Parameter tokenOwner of BoltFinance constructor.
Parameter _supply of BoltFinance constructor.
Parameter _value of BoltFinance.burn.

Local variable oldValue caching the current allowance in decreaseApproval.

normalization_plan.reason: New owner address is only meaningful as the argument of the ownership transfer routine.
Recipient parameter is used solely inside the transfer balance update.
Transfer amount drives the balance arithmetic of the transfer routine.
Source account parameter is used only in the transferFrom balance/allowance update.
Recipient parameter is used only in the transferFrom balance update.
Amount parameter drives the balance and allowance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Mint target account is used only for the balance credit inside mint.
Mint amount drives the totalSupply and balance arithmetic.
Initial owner parameter is consumed only by the constructor initialization.
Supply parameter is consumed only to compute totalSupply in the constructor.
Burn amount is used only as the argument passed into the burn flow.
Local addition result exists only inside SafeMath.add.
Cached allowance value exists only inside decreaseApproval.
